modern/smid-ceramic-mosaic.title: Tree-shaped Ceramic Entrance Relief
modern/smid-ceramic-mosaic.note: Atrium localrender and primary survey photographDSC_9210.JPG visually match the distinctive projecting quarter-circle tiles of the entrance tree. Survey11977 attributes this to Milan Chlíbec. Earlier Šmíd attribution conflates it with a separate courtyard relief at the same school.
